Keyboard, not a flight device. Read from the user's Wooting Two HE (ARM): VID:PID 31E3:1231, HID name 'Wooting Two HE (ARM)'. It enumerates as several HID interfaces; one game-controller interface has axes JOY_Y, JOY_X, JOY_RZ, JOY_Z, JOY_RY, JOY_RX, JOY_RZ(duplicate name), JOY_Y(duplicate name), JOY_SLIDER1, 12 buttons, 1 hat (the analog/gamepad mode, mi_00); the other interfaces (mi_02/03/04) show up as 'game controllers' with 0-674 buttons (keyboard raw/n-key interfaces) and must be ignored. Other Wooting models have other PIDs.
